chunk_1.page_content:
Interface Requirements Specification

Four Packet Formats for Name-Boundary Detection

Document ID: IRS-SAMPLE-004    |    Version: 1.0    |    Status: Draft

chunk_3.page_content:
## 1.1 Purpose

This document defines four illustrative application-level packet formats that carry the same personal identification information. The formats differ in how the Name field is bounded: fixed size, length prefix, termination character, or packet header and footer.

chunk_4.page_content:
## 1.2 Scope

Each packet contains a Name, Age, and Roll Number. The Age and Roll Number fields retain the definitions from the source sample specification.

chunk_5.page_content:
## 1.3 Original Packet Structure

The original packet uses a 6-byte ASCII Header HEADER, a 20-byte ASCII Name padded with NULL bytes, a 1-byte Age, a 1-byte Roll Number, and a 6-byte ASCII Footer FOOTER. Its total size is 34 bytes. Packet 3.1 preserves this structure.

chunk_7.page_content:
## 2.1 Field Order and Byte Numbering

Fields are serialized in the order shown in each Field Layout table. Offsets are zero-based from the first byte of the packet. All sizes are measured in bytes.

chunk_8.page_content:
## 2.2 Character Encoding

Header, Name, Footer, and Name terminator fields use ASCII. Name lengths are measured in encoded bytes. Names shall contain printable ASCII characters except where a packet definition specifies padding.

chunk_9.page_content:
## 2.3 Age and Roll Number

Age occupies exactly 1 byte and is represented as an unsigned 8-bit integer with valid range 0–255. Roll Number occupies exactly 1 byte and is represented as an unsigned 8-bit integer with valid range 0–255. These definitions apply unchanged to all four packets.

chunk_10.page_content:
## 2.4 Common Marker Values

Where present, Header shall contain the six ASCII bytes HEADER. Where present, Footer shall contain the six ASCII bytes FOOTER.

chunk_12.page_content:
### 3.1.1 Packet Overview

This packet preserves the original fixed-length structure. Name always occupies exactly 20 bytes. Short names are padded with NULL bytes.

chunk_13.page_content:
### 3.1.2 Field Layout
Field Size (bytes) Type / Encoding Requirements
Header 6 ASCII Exact value: HEADER.
Name 20 ASCII Exactly 20 bytes. Unused bytes shall be padded with 0x00. Names longer than 20 bytes shall be rejected by default.
Age 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Roll Number 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Footer 6 ASCII Exact value: FOOTER.

chunk_14.page_content:
### 3.1.3 Length and Validation

Expected total size: Exactly 34 bytes.

The packet shall be exactly 34 bytes.

Bytes 0–5 shall contain HEADER.

Bytes 6–25 shall contain the 20-byte Name field, including NULL padding where required.

Byte 26 shall contain Age and byte 27 shall contain Roll Number.

Bytes 28–33 shall contain FOOTER.

Age and Roll Number shall each be interpreted as unsigned 8-bit values.

chunk_16.page_content:
### 3.2.1 Packet Overview

This packet carries a variable-length Name preceded by a one-byte Name Length field. Name Length specifies the exact number of ASCII bytes in Name.

chunk_17.page_content:
### 3.2.2 Field Layout
Field Size (bytes) Type / Encoding Requirements
Header 6 ASCII Exact value: HEADER.
Name Length 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Number of encoded bytes in Name; valid range 1–64. Does not include this prefix.
Name Name Length ASCII Variable length. Its byte length shall equal Name Length. NULL padding is not used.
Age 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Roll Number 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Footer 6 ASCII Exact value: FOOTER.

chunk_18.page_content:
### 3.2.3 Length and Validation

Expected total size: Variable: 15 + Name Length bytes.

The packet shall begin with HEADER and end with FOOTER.

Name Length shall be between 1 and 64, in little endian.

The receiver shall read exactly Name Length bytes for Name.

Age and Roll Number shall each occupy exactly one byte and be interpreted as unsigned 8-bit values.

Total packet length shall equal 15 + Name Length bytes.

Truncated packets and trailing bytes shall be rejected.

chunk_20.page_content:
### 3.3.1 Packet Overview

This packet carries a variable-length Name preceded by a one-byte Name Length field. Name Length specifies the exact number of ASCII bytes in Name.

chunk_21.page_content:
### 3.3.2 Field Layout
Field Size (bytes) Type / Encoding Requirements
Header 6 ASCII Exact value: HEADER.
Name Length 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Number of encoded bytes in Name; valid range 1–64. Including this prefix.
Name Name Length ASCII Variable length. Its byte length shall equal Name Length. NULL padding is not used.
Age 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Roll Number 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Footer 6 ASCII Exact value: FOOTER.

chunk_22.page_content:
### 3.3.3 Length and Validation

Expected total size: Variable: 15 + Name Length bytes.

The packet shall begin with HEADER and end with FOOTER.

Name Length shall be between 1 and 64, in little endian.

The receiver shall read exactly Name Length bytes for Name.

Age and Roll Number shall each occupy exactly one byte and be interpreted as unsigned 8-bit values.

Total packet length shall equal 15 + Name Length bytes.

Truncated packets and trailing bytes shall be rejected.

chunk_24.page_content:
### 3.4.1 Packet Overview

This packet carries a variable-length Name terminated by the ASCII vertical bar character '|'. The terminator is a separate field and is not part of Name.

chunk_25.page_content:
### 3.4.2 Field Layout
Field Size (bytes) Type / Encoding Requirements
Header 6 ASCII Exact value: HEADER.
Age 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Name Variable ASCII Ends at the first occurrence of terminator byte 0x5C. Valid length: 1–64 bytes.
Name Terminator 1 ASCII Exact value: '\' (0x5C). Not included in Name.
Roll Number 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Footer 6 ASCII Exact value: FOOTER.

chunk_26.page_content:
### 3.4.3 Length and Validation

Expected total size: Variable: 15 + Name length bytes.

The packet shall begin with HEADER and end with FOOTER.

The receiver shall locate the first 0x5C byte after Header to determine the end of Name.

Name shall contain 1–64 ASCII bytes and shall not contain an unescaped vertical bar.

The 0x5C terminator shall immediately follow Name and is not part of Name.

Age and Roll Number shall each occupy exactly one byte and be interpreted as unsigned 8-bit values.

The packet shall be rejected if the terminator is missing or the resulting layout is incomplete.

chunk_28.page_content:
### 3.5.1 Packet Overview

This packet uses Header and Footer to identify the beginning and end of the complete packet. Name has no separate length prefix and no termination character. Its length is derived from the packet boundary after accounting for the fixed Age and Roll Number fields.

chunk_29.page_content:
### 3.5.2 Field Layout
Field Size (bytes) Type / Encoding Requirements
Header 6 ASCII Exact value: HEADER. Marks the beginning of the packet.
Age 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255. Located immediately before Roll Number and Footer.
Roll Number 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255. Located immediately before Footer.
Name Variable ASCII Occupies the variable-length region after Header and before the fixed trailing fields. Valid length: 1–64 bytes.
Footer 6 ASCII Exact value: FOOTER. Marks the end of the packet.

chunk_30.page_content:
### 3.5.3 Length and Validation

Expected total size: Variable: 14 + Name length bytes.

The receiver shall locate HEADER to identify the beginning of a candidate packet.

The receiver shall locate FOOTER to identify the end of the candidate packet.

Age and Roll Number are the two bytes immediately preceding FOOTER.

Name consists of all bytes between Header and Age.

Name shall contain 1–64 ASCII bytes and shall not contain the complete FOOTER marker sequence.

Total packet length shall equal 14 + Name length bytes.

The packet shall be rejected if either marker is missing, markers are out of order, or derived Name length is outside the permitted range.

chunk_31.page_content:
# 4. CROSS-PACKET INTERFACE SUMMARY
Packet Name Name Boundary Mechanism Name Size Packet Size
Fixed Identity Packet Fixed field size Exactly 20 bytes 34 bytes
Length-Prefixed Identity Packet One-byte length prefix 1–64 bytes 15 + Name Length
Delimited Identity Packet ASCII '|' terminator 1–64 bytes 15 + Name Length
Header-Footer Bounded Identity Packet Packet Header and Footer 1–64 bytes 14 + Name Length

chunk_33.page_content:
## 5.1 Fixed-Length Packet

The Fixed Identity Packet shall be validated against its exact 34-byte size and fixed field offsets.

chunk_34.page_content:
## 5.2 Variable-Length Packets

The Length-Prefixed Identity Packet derives Name length from Name Length. The Delimited Identity Packet derives Name length from the 0x5C terminator. The Header-Footer Bounded Identity Packet derives Name length from the complete packet boundary and the fixed trailing Age and Roll Number fields.

chunk_35.page_content:
## 5.3 Common Numeric Field Validation

For all four packet types, Age and Roll Number shall each be exactly one byte and shall be interpreted as unsigned 8-bit integers with valid values from 0 through 255.

chunk_36.page_content:
# 6. DOCUMENT NOTES

The first packet retains the original sample packet's field sizes, marker values, field order, and Age/Roll Number definitions. The remaining three packets change the mechanism used to determine the Name field boundary. Each packet has at most one Header field; no packet uses duplicate or nested headers.

Original demonstration values: Name = HAARD SHAH; Age = 22; Roll Number = 15.
